card.line: The Valley of Shaveh, also called the King's Valley, is where Abram was met after his victory, and where Absalom later set up his pillar.

moments.title: Abram Meets the Kings
moments.text: After Abram defeated Chedorlaomer and the kings with him, the king of Sodom went out to meet him in the Valley of Shaveh. Melchizedek, priest of God Most High, brought bread and wine and blessed Abram, and Abram gave him a tenth of everything.

moments.title: Absalom's Monument
moments.text: Absalom set up a pillar for himself in the King's Valley. He said he had no son to keep the memory of his name, so he gave the pillar his name. It was still called Absalom's Monument when this was written.
